title: What if I let go?
note: A generated image; the model saw it at 1.7 times real size; times are real time.

facts.what: A hand lets go of a ball of sand about 7 cm above the sand (the size estimated from the image). As wet sand (plasticine) the ball lands as a flattened lump; as the model’s dry sand, which has no cohesion, it bursts into a wide spray
facts.extra: The hand is the image’s own pixels. The same seed for both materials.
facts.sel: Seed 0; 8 of 8 seeds pass the selection rule for each material
